name: covariate_construction_monthly_housing_starts
citation: FRED (US Census, BLS, Federal Reserve, IMF, LBMA)
license: public domain / FRED terms of use
description: c1-housing-starts — 'Housing starts' forecasting bundle. Native cadence monthly; 437 timesteps 1990-01-01..2026-05-01. Non-EIA sources. Known-future covariates: none (all covariates are past-only). NO contemporaneous covariates — all covariates enter as past values only; known-future covariates (weather forecasts, scheduled budgets/releases) are genuinely available at forecast time. Timestamp-derived calendar features are NOT included — time information is carried only by the timestamps column.
preprocessing: 1. curl FRED fredgraph.csv per series (plain UA + --http1.1; browser UA triggers HTTP/2 reset)
3. resample to month-start mean (weekly MORTGAGE30US and daily DTWEXBGS/GOLDAMGBD228NLBM -> monthly mean; monthly series unchanged)

4. Renamed raw source fields to human-readable (FRED series ID -> column): HOUST->Housing starts, PERMIT->Building permits, MORTGAGE30US->30-year fixed mortgage rate, CES2023610001->Residential construction employment, MSACSR->Months supply of new houses, DSPIC96->Real disposable personal income, WPU081->Lumber PPI.

8. Reformatted wide -> TempusBench long (variable_name, variable_unit, timestamps, values); variable names are human-readable English; timestamp-derived calendar features dropped (time lives only in the timestamps column); timestamps ISO-8601 UTC-labelled, shared across variables; missing -> null; CSV-writer quoted.
